text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp has once again rolled<n>around, and
this year, we'll focus on<n>training for the upcoming
Arima Kinen<n>and autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
When I give Biwa Hayahide her<n>training schedule,
she nods<n>approvingly.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This is incredible. You managed to<n>find all this
information on the autumn<n>Tenno Sho?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You even included data on the ArimaKinen and Brian's predicted times forthe Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
How much time did you spend on<n>this? It must
have been so much<n>work!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Then for the purpose of solidifying my<n>winning
equation, I graciously accept<n>your support.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'll work hard for both our sakes.
